question: What is the greatest integer less than or equal to \[\dfrac{3^{100}+2^{100}}{3^{96}+2^{96}}?\]
solution:
Because \(3^{100}=81\cdot3^{96}\) and \(2^{100}=16\cdot2^{96}\), compare the fraction with \(81\), then with \(80\).

Write
\[
N=3^{100}+2^{100},\qquad D=3^{96}+2^{96}>0.
\]
First,
\[
N-81D=(16-81)2^{96}=-65\cdot2^{96}<0,
\]
so \(N/D<81\).

For the lower bound,
\[
\begin{aligned}
N-80D
&=(81-80)3^{96}+(16-80)2^{96}\\
&=3^{96}-64\cdot2^{96}\\
&=3^{96}-2^{102}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(3^2=9>8=2^3\), raising both sides to the 48th power gives
\[
3^{96}=(3^2)^{48}>(2^3)^{48}=2^{144}>2^{102}.
\]
Thus \(N-80D>0\), so \(N/D>80\). We have proved
\[
80<\frac{3^{100}+2^{100}}{3^{96}+2^{96}}<81.
\]
The greatest integer less than or equal to the fraction is \(\boxed{80}\), choice A.
